QUOTE: "With no default configured, the pointers start as `platform_calloc_uninit`, which returns NULL, and `platform_free_uninit`, which does nothing (`platform.c:25-42`). Until you call the setter, every library allocation fails."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised calloc pointer returns NULL and the uninitialised free does nothing, so allocations fail rather than fall back to a default.
